pdrm_crime_district.name: Crimes by District & Crime Type (crime_district)
pdrm_crime_district.publisher: Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) and Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM), via data.gov.my
pdrm_crime_district.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as stated on the data.gov.my catalogue page
pdrm_crime_district.notes: Kept type 'murder' (category 'assault'), annual counts. Catalogue methodology: tabulated from report-level data of the Police Reporting System; it states the figures are 'actual crimes (i.e. where a conviction has already occurred) rather than the number of reported crimes'. W.P. Putrajaya data appear as a police district under W.P. Kuala Lumpur, and W.P. Labuan under Sabah (per catalogue); they were matched to the Putrajaya ADM1 and Labuan ADM2 shapes. National 'Malaysia' rows not kept. Some police districts appear under two spellings in different years (e.g. Bandar Bharu / Bandar Baharu, Sg. Buloh / Sungai Buloh, Cameron Highland / Cameron Highlands) - kept as published.

problems: Police districts were matched to geoBoundaries administrative districts (ADM2) only where the names are the same or a plain spelling/alias of the same district (Hulu Selangor=Ulu Selangor, Bandar Bharu=Bandar Baharu, Cameron Highland(s), Kota Kinabatangan=Kinabatangan, Kuala Lipis=Lipis, Kota Samarahan=Samarahan, Meradong=Maradong). Police district boundaries may still differ from administrative ones. Urban police districts (Kuala Lumpur divisions, Selangor and Johor Bahru splits, Perak and Perlis police districts named after towns) have no matching shape.
